characters.name: Askeladden
characters.prompt: A resourceful young boy with a simple yet cunning demeanor, wearing tattered rural clothes, holding a knapsack, and standing with a mischievous grin, defying traditional expectations in a dense Scandinavian forest.

characters.name: The Troll

characters.name: The Old Farmer
